recipe.build:
sed -r 's/isUniversalApk = true/isUniversalApk = false/ ; s/include\(.*/include("arm64-v8a")/' -i app/build.gradle.kts
sed -r '/signingConfigs.findByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
sed -r 's/versionCode \= Integer.*/versionCode = 2025030601/' -i build-gradle-plugin-configurator/src/main/kotlin/kmp/BaseApplication.kt
touch android-signing-keystore.jks
echo -e "signing_keystore_password=signing_keystore_password\nsigning_key_alias=signing_key_alias\nsigning_key_password=signing_key_password" > secrets.properties
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleRelease
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
